blocks.html: Leading real estate company Robinsons Land was recently conferred as the Best Developer in the Philippines by real estate portal Dot Property in its annual awards program. “Robinsons Land stands out for its commitment to building quality housing for all Filipinos,” explained Dot Property Philippines country manager Tanya Yu. “We felt that all of the developer’s projects offer unmatched quality despite being targeted to different segments. Someone purchasing a residential property from Robinsons Land knows they are getting the best,” she said. Robinsons Land president Frederick D.Go affirmed the company’s commitment to continuously innovate the market through residential offerings that are truly relevant and value-laden toward the various needs of Filipino homeseekers. “This award is significant in illustrating our success in developing projects that provide genuine value to today’s Filipino home buyers,” he said. “The award also affirms our success in making use of modern technology and digital tools in bringing our projects to market more effectively and more efficiently.” Dot Property Philippines is a pioneering online portal with search features that allow property buyers to find the perfect house, villa, apartment or condominium for residential use or for investment purposes. “We also value Robinsons Land’s desire to build projects that provide work-life balance. Modern life has changed how people work and this is something Robinsons Land has recognized. Several of their projects are designed with numerous conveniences that ensure residents are able to get the most out of life, regardless of how busy they are. The creation of these live-work-play environments at their projects has revolutionized real estate in the Philippines,” added Yu. Among the projects of Robinsons Land that Dot Property Philippines highlighted are Robinsons Luxuria’s The Residences at The Westin Manila Sonata Place, the first Westin-branded luxury condominium development in the Philippines; as well as Robinsons Residences’ The Sapphire Bloc, a pioneering high-rise vertical community with a mixed-use component that has created a cultural destination in the city with its unique restaurants and dining establishments. To know more about The Residences at The Westin Manila Sonata Place, visit the Show Suite located at 21st Drive and McKinley Parkway, Bonifacio Global City or log on to www.sonatapremier.com. For more information on The Sapphire Bloc, call the Robinsons Residences hotline at 636-0888 or (0925) 333-3333, or visit www.robinsonsresidences.com and www.facebook.com/RobResidences.###
